name: DiscordSoundboard
description: Simple soundboard for discord. You can trigger sounds by commands typed in the Discord chat, or you can choose the sound from the web UI. You will need to create a bot account that the bot will use to join and play sounds. The bot can only play sounds/respond to commands for servers it has been given access. Get your bot token from here - https://discord.com/developers/applications. This will not work correctly without a proper Bot Token and the bot application being added to your discord server. Join the official discord: https://discord.gg/kZTNtfW for support

paths.name: Sound Dirs
paths.description: Container Path: Point to a directory of .mp3/.wave files to make accessible in the bot.

variables.name: Bot Token
variables.description: Container Variable: bottoken Help on how to get a bot token: https://github.com/Darkside138/DiscordSoundboard/wiki

variables.name: Discord Username
variables.description: Container Variable: username This is the name of the bot owner.

variables.name: Admin Role User ID List
variables.description: List of discord user id's you like to have admin role. Comma-separated

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: https://discord.com/developers/applications Select your application and go to OAuth2 in the menu. This is where you get client id and client secret. Add a redirect to your soundboardURL/login/oauth2/code/discord

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Set this to a unique value. You can generate one here: https://jwtgenerator.com/tools/jwt-generator
